extras: Include payload_sha256 on request/message errors only where the payload hash does not reveal a hash of tokens, signatures, MACs or key material

Throughout implementation, investigate a CI job that fails twice rather than retrying further; quarantine any flaky test with @flaky and a ticket within one working day, then fix or delete it within two weeks

During rollout, if a page affects sync for more than 1% of devices for more than ten minutes, follow the documented incident declaration, coordination and post-incident review within five working days
Use contextual Go errors where applicable, prefer Result at Kotlin module boundaries, and cap any retry loops with jittered backoff
Review the non-blocking perf report against the documented cold-start and bundle-size budgets
Have on-call check the migration's lock/runtime estimate against current production load ... Allow up to one working day after merge
